enunciado: Insert 1 to 7 in order into an AVL tree. After each insertion recompute heights and, if a node becomes unbalanced (|balance| > 1), apply the right rotation (single or double), showing it. Compare the final height with the degenerate BST's (6).
pistas: Balance < -1 with insertion right of the right child: rotate left.
Rotations return the new root of the subtree.
